row.team_price_text: Develop: from $29/mo flat (1 Cloud seat, then $30/seat/mo; unlimited Admin users), billed monthly
row.evidence: Medusa's pricing page lists "RBAC, SSO, Audit Logs" only in the Enterprise (Custom, Contact Us) plan, and neither the pricing page, the docs (llms-full.txt) nor the Admin API reference documents SCIM; Okta sign-in is a do-it-yourself auth-provider tutorial.
row.notes: New row. Medusa is an open-source commerce framework with a hosted Medusa Cloud. Cloud plans are flat, billed monthly: Develop from $29/mo, Launch from $99/mo, Scale from $299/mo, Enterprise custom; Cloud (developer platform) seats are 1/1/3 included then $30/seat/mo, and Medusa Admin dashboard users are free and unlimited, so per-user prices are null. SSO (with RBAC and audit logs) is Enterprise only. No SCIM endpoint or IdP catalogue app exists; the docs include a developer tutorial for building an Okta OIDC auth provider that creates an admin user for a newly authenticated Okta user (custom code, not a product feature). The open-source Admin API (all plans, including self-hosted) lists, gets, updates and deletes admin users and manages invites. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

plans.notes: 1 Cloud seat included, then $30/seat/mo; unlimited Admin users.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: RBAC, SSO and Audit Logs; no audit-log API documented.

scim.notes: No 'SCIM' string in docs.medusajs.com/llms-full.txt (1.4 MB, full docs) or the Admin API OpenAPI spec; the pricing page lists SSO but not SCIM for Enterprise. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

capabilities.notes: Users cannot be created directly in the Admin; they are invited and created on invite acceptance. RBAC is an Enterprise Cloud feature with no documented API.

endpoints.purpose: Generate a reset-password token for a user

user_api.notes: This is the store's Admin API (Medusa Admin users), part of the open-source app on every plan and self-hosted. Medusa Cloud organization members/seats have no documented API.

okta.notes: No OIN app. Medusa documents a self-built Okta OIDC auth provider for the Admin instead (c18, c19).

fallbacks.other_sync: Developer-built Okta OIDC auth provider (docs tutorial) that creates an admin user on first Okta login; custom code, not a product feature
